raw_content_profile_conformance.classification: routine_existing_reader_behavior; no new G norm requested
raw_content_profile_conformance.behavior: Readers parse exact raw manifest bytes; absent profile refuses by default; malformed-present and selected-view mismatch refuse; unknown profile is raw/candidate-only; declared-profile payload hash and round-trip are checked under the selected facade allowlist.

facade_law.behavior: Common canonical mechanics receive profile-specific error type and tag set. Core accepts array_digest/bytes_hex/float_hex in addition to shared tags; IR keeps its narrower set and distinct public exception identity.

g_decisions_requested.question: Does polisyos.canon.json@0.2.0 name shared mechanics/settings while Core and IR retain contextual strict tag laws, or must the persisted identity/version distinguish their accepted tag grammars?
g_decisions_requested.recommendation_while_pending: Keep existing Core/IR allowlists and refusal behavior. Do not widen IR, rename/version persisted identities, rewrite CAS identifiers, or add a default profile before G adjudicates.

options.choice: Affirm the shared name/version labels common canonical mechanics and declared codec settings; tag acceptance remains facade-contextual and must be enforced by each strict reader.

impacts.compatibility: Lowest migration cost; preserves current bytes, IDs, exception identities and facade defaults.
impacts.consumer_semantics: A shared identity does not promise identical accepted payload sets. Cross-facade semantic reads may fail closed.
impacts.authority_status_time: The profile hash selects a manifest view. It does not attest producer identity, grant authority, or establish currentness/time validity.
impacts.required_next_check: Record G wording that contextual tag policy is part of each facade reader contract and preserve the Core-only tag refusal falsifier.

options.choice: Require explicit persisted identity/version for each accepted tag family.

impacts.compatibility: Higher persisted-format cost. Requires additive schema/version design, old-byte goldens, explicit compatibility readers/writers and migration treatment; preserve old addresses and do not silently rewrite.
impacts.consumer_semantics: Accepted tag law becomes explicit in the selected profile identity.
impacts.authority_status_time: Still does not attest producer or currentness; profile-family identity is format evidence only.
impacts.required_next_check: Before implementation, approve the exact version/field law and demonstrate old/new readers against retained byte fixtures.

property_vs_implementation.property: Persisted profile identity must not imply a broader accepted grammar than the selected reader actually enforces.
property_vs_implementation.current_code: Both facades use the shared 0.2.0 label and supply distinct allowlists to common mechanics.
property_vs_implementation.divergent_case: A persisted Core array_digest artifact is accepted by Core and refused by IR. This is consistent with option shared_mechanics_contextual_tag_law and falsifies an interpretation that 0.2.0 alone means one universal grammar.

producer_profile_semantics.finding: A caller can provide caller-owned canonical bytes and options through put_bytes; a reader can then verify the selected profile/content. This establishes reader conformance, not which producer/spec emitted the bytes.
producer_profile_semantics.proposal: Keep producer origin unestablished unless a named consumer requires and supplies a separately verified typed provenance input. Do not add a self-attested issuer, producer field, or inferred authority to this decision.

minimum_behavioral_discriminators.expected: Supported readers produce declared byte-conformant semantics; Core accepts its declared Core tag and IR refuses that Core-only tag.

minimum_behavioral_discriminators.expected: Fail closed on selected-view/content mismatch; do not substitute another profile or reader default. If the raw surface can independently admit the bytes, preserve them as raw only.

minimum_behavioral_discriminators.input: Profile field absent from a historical manifest.
minimum_behavioral_discriminators.expected: Default semantic read refuses; exact raw bytes remain available on the raw surface; any named candidate-only path cannot expose its value as semantic .value.

minimum_behavioral_discriminators.input: Raw profile has duplicate keys, missing required CanonInfo field, wrong type or an extra field.
